mutations.description: Replace the 2025 ship-date range with a non-null parameter tautology.
mutations.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date AS month, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL) AS average_delivery_days, COUNT(s.delivery_date) AS completed_shipment_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NULL) AS missing_delivery_date_count FROM commerce.shipments AS s WHERE $1::date IS NOT NULL AND $2::date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Move the exclusive end boundary one day earlier, omitting 2025-12-31.
mutations.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date AS month, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL) AS average_delivery_days, COUNT(s.delivery_date) AS completed_shipment_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NULL) AS missing_delivery_date_count FROM commerce.shipments AS s WHERE s.ship_date >= $1 AND s.ship_date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Count non-NULL delivery dates under the missing-date predicate.
mutations.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date AS month, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NOT NULL) AS average_delivery_days, COUNT(s.delivery_date) AS completed_shipment_count, COUNT(s.delivery_date) FILTER (WHERE s.delivery_date IS NULL) AS missing_delivery_date_count FROM commerce.shipments AS s WHERE s.ship_date >= $1 AND s.ship_date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.ship_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Remove the Hai Phong constraint while keeping the bound parameter valid.
mutations.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM commerce.customers AS c JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = c.zip WHERE c.age_group = $1 AND c.signup_date >= $2 AND c.signup_date < $3 LIMIT 1

mutations.description: Use age group 35-44 instead of the requested 25-34.
mutations.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM commerce.customers AS c JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = c.zip WHERE g.city = $1 AND c.age_group = $2 AND c.signup_date >= $3 AND c.signup_date < $4 LIMIT 1

mutations.description: Join geography ZIP to customer_id instead of customers.zip.
mutations.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM commerce.customers AS c JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON g.zip = c.customer_id WHERE g.city = $1 AND c.age_group = $2 AND c.signup_date >= $3 AND c.signup_date < $4 LIMIT 1
mutations.error_detail: JOIN does not match an approved relationship.

mutations.description: Remove the return_reason IS NOT NULL constraint.
mutations.sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, r.return_reason ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Select NULL reasons instead of non-NULL reasons.
mutations.sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 AND r.return_reason IS NULL GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, r.return_reason ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Rank net revenue ascending rather than descending.
mutations.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue ASC, p.category ASC LIMIT 3

mutations.description: Use TOP 5 instead of the requested TOP 3.
mutations.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, p.category ASC LIMIT 5

mutations.description: Remove the business TOP 3 and retain only the executor's safe maximum cap (200 rows).
mutations.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, p.category ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Use MAX(return_quantity) instead of SUM(return_quantity).
mutations.sql: SELECT r.product_id, MAX(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.product_id ORDER BY returned_units DESC, r.product_id ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Aggregate all return rows together without grouping by product_id.
mutations.sql: SELECT SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Count every non-NULL stockout flag, including FALSE rows.
mutations.sql: SELECT i.category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.stockout_flag IS NOT NULL) AS stockout_product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS observed_product_count FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 GROUP BY i.category ORDER BY stockout_product_count DESC, i.category ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Compute before minus after instead of after minus before.
mutations.sql: SELECT i.product_id, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_before, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) AS stock_after, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) - MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 OR i.snapshot_date = $2 GROUP BY i.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.snapshot_date) = 2 ORDER BY stock_delta DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Compare against 2025-11-30 instead of the requested 2025-10-31 snapshot.
mutations.sql: SELECT i.product_id, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_before, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) AS stock_after, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) - MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 OR i.snapshot_date = $2 GROUP BY i.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.snapshot_date) = 2 ORDER BY stock_delta DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Remove the requirement that each product be present in both snapshots.
mutations.sql: SELECT i.product_id, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_before, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) AS stock_after, MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $2) - MAX(i.stock_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 OR i.snapshot_date = $2 GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY stock_delta DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Use 2025 instead of the inherited 2024 year for the monthly COGS follow-up.
mutations.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date AS month, SUM(s.cogs) AS cogs FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 12

mutations.description: Count all statuses rather than only delivered orders in inherited 2025 scope.
mutations.sql: SELECT o.order_source, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 GROUP BY o.order_source ORDER BY order_count DESC, o.order_source ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
mutations.semantic_validator_error_detail: The request requires the include order-status population delivered; preserve its commerce.orders.order_status filter.

mutations.description: Use 2024 instead of inherited 2025 for the delivered-order follow-up.
mutations.sql: SELECT o.order_source, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY o.order_source ORDER BY order_count DESC, o.order_source ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Shift 2023 gross-profit rows one month later before aligning them to 2024.
mutations.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS month, SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cogs) AS gross_profit FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) = 2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SELECT m.month, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS gross_profit_2023, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) AS gross_profit_2024, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) - MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS difference_2024_minus_2023 FROM monthly AS m GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC LIMIT 12

mutations.description: Use gross revenue alone instead of SUM(revenue)-SUM(cogs).
mutations.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) AS month, SUM(s.revenue) AS gross_profit FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date)) SELECT m.month, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS gross_profit_2023, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) AS gross_profit_2024, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) - MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS difference_2024_minus_2023 FROM monthly AS m GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC LIMIT 12

mutations.description: Drop 2024 from the inherited year-over-year comparison window.
mutations.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date) AS month, SUM(s.revenue) - SUM(s.cogs) AS gross_profit FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.date)) SELECT m.month, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS gross_profit_2023, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) AS gross_profit_2024, MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2024) - MAX(m.gross_profit) FILTER (WHERE m.sales_year = 2023) AS difference_2024_minus_2023 FROM monthly AS m GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month ASC LIMIT 12

mutations.description: Remove the business TOP 2 and retain only the executor's safe maximum cap (200 rows).
mutations.sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY returned_units DESC, r.return_reason ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

mutations.description: Rank return quantity ascending rather than descending.
mutations.sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY returned_units ASC, r.return_reason ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2

mutations.description: Use reverse alphabetical order for equal return quantities instead of ascending reason names.
mutations.sql: SELECT r.return_reason, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.return_reason ORDER BY returned_units DESC, r.return_reason DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 2

mutations.description: Use the 2025-09-30 snapshot instead of inherited 2025-10-31.
mutations.sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.stockout_days FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = $1 ORDER BY i.stockout_days DESC, i.product_id ASC LIMIT 5

mutations.description: Divide line-item revenue by joined order rows rather than distinct orders.
mutations.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id), 0) AS average_order_value FROM commerce.orders AS o JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = $1 AND o.order_date >= $2 AND o.order_date < $3 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 12
mutations.error_detail: Aggregate input may be duplicated by a one-to-many join. Aggregate from its source without the multiplying join, or use COUNT(DISTINCT key) for entity counts. SUM(DISTINCT value) does not restore source grain.
